ad: Gertrude Bell Archive, Album S: Hasankeyf ("Hassan Kef")

kayit_no: GB/3/1/19/1 (albüm). Örnek öğe GB/3/1/19/1/73, eski referans S_073
lisans: The licence terms could not be read in this research; the Terms page of the site should be checked. Since Bell died in 1926, the works are most likely in the public domain, but the institution sets the terms of use for digital images.
not: There is an IIIF manifest. The records have a coordinate field, which makes placing them on the map easier.
